name: PM-LLM-Benchmark
description: PM-LLM-Benchmark is the first comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate large language models on process mining tasks, focusing on domain-specific knowledge and various implementation strategies. It assesses the capability of commercial and open-source LLMs to perform process mining analyses and highlights challenges related to data availability and evaluation biases.
reputation: A first-of-its-kind benchmark for process mining with LLMs that is relevant to the process mining community, though still early in adoption.
notes: Focuses on process mining domain knowledge; highlights evaluation biases and challenges for small models.
